assumptions.mass: User-reported approximately 50 lb, including all six propeller links and the contact link.
assumptions.inertia: Uniform density over the multipart high-resolution CAD material representation, normalized to total mass. This is a geometry-based prior, not measured inertia.
assumptions.center_of_mass: Aggregate CG is assumed at the body-frame origin to match the current mixer; the CAD uniform-density centroid is not treated as measured CG.
assumptions.buoyancy: Assumed 0.2 kg positive buoyancy; CB 2 cm above CG follows the relative separation in the borrowed BlueROV2 reference after converting its NED frame to our z-up frame.
assumptions.drag: Unscaled BlueROV2 coefficients borrowed as a starting model. CAD silhouettes are recorded separately; no claim of identified coefficients or matched frame openness.
assumptions.added_mass: Provisional isotropic translational added mass: the mean of the three borrowed BlueROV2 translation values, preserving their sum without imposing another hull's unverified directional anisotropy and Munk tipping torque. Rotational values remain borrowed. DART native fluid_added_mass; plugin added mass disabled. This regularization is not measured hydrodynamics or proof of full vehicle stability.
assumptions.collision: Enclosing box of configured rendered CAD with 5 mm padding; frame openings are filled. Contact volume is excluded from buoyancy.

sources.buoyancy_pattern_note: Bumblebee's example separates visible geometry and displacement, but its BlueROV2 dynamics are explicitly untuned; its coefficients were not used here.
sources.units: Linear translation: N s/m; quadratic translation: N s^2/m^2; linear rotation: N m s/rad; quadratic rotation: N m s^2/rad^2; added mass: kg and kg m^2.
